FeaturedMissions.title: Featured Deployments
FeaturedMissions.subtitle: A selection of secure, scalable, and automation-driven systems I've engineered.
FeaturedMissions.ciphervault_desc: A full-stack steganography system that hides AES-256 encrypted text inside images using ML-ranked pixels and LSB embedding. Includes a FastAPI backend, Next.js frontend, and real-time quality metrics (PSNR, SSIM, BER). Built for a cybersecurity master's thesis.
FeaturedMissions.mulhamai_desc: An Arabic-first AI platform for building and selling digital products. Users describe an idea and the AI generates a complete product — name, content (2000+ words), pricing, and a marketing plan. Features an 8-step wizard, seller dashboard, Tap Payments integration, and a multi-stage AI pipeline (Mulhim Brain).
FeaturedMissions.tanseeq_desc: A service-platform web app with user authentication, profile management, an admin dashboard, and dynamic content exploration. Built with Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Appwrite, and Firebase. Deployed live on Vercel.
FeaturedMissions.linkedpro_desc: A LinkedIn automation platform powered by a multi-agent AI system. Handles AI-generated content, automated job applications with custom cover letters, network automation, and engagement analytics. Built with FastAPI, Python, MongoDB, and Playwright.
